name: Fee 11
definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

Basis.name: Basis
Basis.definition: Method used to calculate the fee (charge/commission).

StandardAmount.name: Standard Amount
StandardAmount.definition: Standard fee (charge/commission) amount as specified in the fund prospectus or agreed for the account.

StandardRate.name: Standard Rate
StandardRate.definition: Standard fee (charge/commission) rate used to calculate the amount of the charge or fee, as specified in the fund prospectus or agreed for the account.

DiscountDetails.name: Discount Details
DiscountDetails.definition: Discount or waiver applied to the fee (charge/commission).

AppliedAmount.name: Applied Amount
AppliedAmount.definition: Fee (charge/commission) amount applied to the transaction.

AppliedRate.name: Applied Rate
AppliedRate.definition: Final rate used to calculate the fee (charge/commission) amount.

NonStandardSLAReference.name: Non Standard SLA Reference
NonStandardSLAReference.definition: Reference to a sales agreement that overrides normal processing or the Service Level Agreement (SLA), such as a fee (charge/commission).

RecipientIdentification.name: Recipient Identification
RecipientIdentification.definition: Party entitled to the amount of money resulting from a fee (charge/commission).

InformativeIndicator.name: Informative Indicator
InformativeIndicator.definition: Indicates the information is provided for information purposes only. When the value is ‘false’ or ‘0’ the amount provided is taken into consideration in the transaction overhead. When the value is ‘true’ or ‘1’ the amount provided is not taken into consideration in the transaction overhead.

AppliedAmountRule.definition: If InformativeIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then AppliedAmount must be present.
